products.notes: Agricultural-grade prilled urea from the Augusta, Georgia source. Guaranteed minimum total nitrogen is 46.0%. Typical SGN is 203 with a stated 185-215 range; typical bulk density is 46 lb/ft3 with a guaranteed 44-48 lb/ft3 range. The sheet lists 1.76% maximum methylenediurea conditioner, 0.5% maximum biuret, and 0.3% maximum moisture. No universal application rate is stated; calculate product rate from the desired actual-nitrogen rate and follow the current agronomic recommendation.
